calls.bash: mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim r2 -w eval --for w2
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do r2 and close it'
git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path w2 -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w2) rev-parse HEAD)
